description: U.S. assets excluding financial derivatives (Change in position attributable to changes in volume and valuation n.i.e.); annual

notes: Changes in volume and valuation n.i.e. (not included elsewhere) includes changes due to shifts in the composition of reporting panels and to the incorporation of more comprehensive survey results.
